params.sources: Positions are fractions of the canvas. 'meld' = geometry copied from the user's Meld H scene (2026-10-30 run, April 2026 session file); 'spec' = measured from the reference screenshot (about 1 percent accuracy) because the Meld box was more than 2 percentage points away or no Meld layer matched. Crops are in source pixels and UNVERIFIED against Meld (centred).

layers.name: Game backdrop (blurred)
layers.note: Blurred copy of the game capture filling the whole canvas behind every layer (user request 2026-11-10, D331; replaces the atmos-frame browser background). No crop: the 16:9 source fills the 16:9 canvas without stretching. Blur strength 71 = sigma 35.5 source px = 35.5 canvas px at scale 1, the same on-screen blur as the V backdrop (strength 40 = sigma 20 source px x 1.78 = 35.5 canvas px); proposed, UNVERIFIED on a real capture, tunable in the Look panel. Not behind a feature flag (user request). An unbound game capture leaves a transparent placeholder.

layers.name: Game capture
layers.note: Rounded frame in Meld. Crop, not stretch: see the evidence file. Rounded corners (radius 64 source px, about 58 canvas px at scale 0.905, from the user horizontal target layout 2026-11-07) with feature flag layer-effects; radius proposed, UNVERIFIED.

layers.name: Facecam
layers.note: Meld flips this source (rotation 180 plus a negative vertical scale, a horizontal mirror); the project placement cannot flip, so it is left unflipped.

layers.name: Wordmark
layers.note: Brand asset, local only. When the profile wordmark is a video (green screen, as in Meld), it is keyed with the Meld values (chromaKey 300/1) while feature flag layer-effects is on; a still image is not keyed (D248). Shown at its true shape inside this box, cut to where the text ever appears: black bars and the always-green border are cropped first (fit contain + cropBars + trimKey, user choices 2026-11-08, D251); Meld stretched the whole frame.

layers.name: Goal bar
layers.note: Left out for now (user 2026-11-08): hidden; the layer stays so it can be switched on. Geometry from the target layout (top left, above the wordmark).

layers.name: Twitch follower counter
layers.note: Live count (D250, flag live-counters): page ujwalam-counter reads the latest count from the overlay server; the count comes from a Streamer.bot global the user keeps (data/counters.json), plus live follows. Empty while the flag is off or before the first read; the legacy HUD showed fixed numbers.

layers.name: Subscribe call to action
layers.note: YouTube subscribe pill. Keyed looping video from the stream assets folder (base media; file name in the local profile key). Shown only with feature flag layer-effects, since without the key the green background would show. Key values are the Meld import of this layer (D246 mapping, UNVERIFIED for other footage).

layers.name: YouTube subscriber counter
layers.note: Live count (D250, flag live-counters): page ujwalam-counter reads the latest count from the overlay server; the count comes from a Streamer.bot global the user keeps (data/counters.json), plus live follows. Empty while the flag is off or before the first read; the legacy HUD showed fixed numbers.

layers.name: Social ticker
layers.note: Legacy page reads its handles from the brand config, not from the URL; the bindings are carried for the host.

layers.name: Character cutout
layers.note: Mascot, bottom right over the game frame corner (user horizontal target layout 2026-11-07; box measured to about 1 percent). Shown at its true shape inside the box. Brand asset, local only: without the profile key the layer is a transparent placeholder (layer off).

layers.name: Effects (full canvas)
layers.note: One transparent full-canvas page; other effects join through the effect gate.

layers.name: Atmos front
layers.note: Hidden: no matching layer in the Meld session.

layers.name: Test broadcast
layers.note: Test-stream announcement (preset test-broadcast, BM3). Left column over the event list, beside the game (moved 2026-11-07, D232: the old top-of-game rect covered 51 % of the CODM score/timer and 60 % of the minimap, HUD safe-zone check). Above everything. Always in the scene; the page shows the banner only while the test-broadcast flag is on (polled live, D196). Own page, not a legacy overlay. Rect is a proposal, UNVERIFIED on a real capture.

changelog: 0.6.0 (2026-11-10, D331): the atmos-frame browser background is replaced by game-backdrop, a blurred duplicate of the game capture over the full canvas, behind every layer; no feature flag.
